theory Combinatory

Combinatory logic

SKI combinators and Church numerals, booleans, and pairs.

Combinatory logic and Church encodings.

The SKI basis is complete for the typed λ-calculus: `S`, `K`, and `I` inhabit the corresponding combinatory types, and `S K K` converts with `I`. This theory formalizes the core combinator algebra (SKI, B, CFlip, W), their typing and conversion identities, and polymorphic Church encodings for natural numbers, booleans, and pairs, along with algebraic laws.

27 theorems, 25 abstractions, checked by replaying their tactic scripts on the kernel. Hover any piece of syntax for its kind, surface form, and uniform term; open Tactics, Proof, or Analysis to go deeper.

Original source file
-- | Combinatory logic and Church encodings.
--
-- The SKI basis is complete for the typed λ-calculus: `S`, `K`, and `I`
-- inhabit the corresponding combinatory types, and `S K K` converts with `I`.
-- This theory formalizes the core combinator algebra (SKI, B, CFlip, W),
-- their typing and conversion identities, and polymorphic Church encodings
-- for natural numbers, booleans, and pairs, along with algebraic laws.
theory Combinatory

comment book "Combinatory logic, SKI basis, and polymorphic Church encodings."

abs I == λx. x
abs K == λx. λy. x
abs S == λf. λg. λx. (f x) (g x)
abs Bcomb == λf. λg. λx. f (g x)
abs CFlip == λf. λx. λy. f y x
abs W == λf. λx. f x x

-- Church numerals (polymorphic iterators).
abs CNat == ⋂A:U{i}. (A → A) → A → A
abs C0 == λs. λz. z
abs C1 == λs. λz. s z
abs C2 == λs. λz. s (s z)
abs C3 == λs. λz. s (s (s z))
abs CSucc == λn. λs. λz. s (n s z)
abs CPlus == λm. λn. λs. λz. m s (n s z)
abs CMult == λm. λn. λs. m (n s)
abs CToInt(n) == n (λx. x + 1) 0

-- Church booleans.
abs CBool == ⋂A:U{i}. A → A → A
abs CTrue == λt. λf. t
abs CFalse == λt. λf. f
abs CIf(b) == b
abs CAnd(p; q) == p q CFalse
abs COr(p; q) == p CTrue q
abs CNot(p) == p CFalse CTrue

-- Church pairs.
abs CPair(x; y) == λf. f x y
abs CFst(p) == p (λx. λy. x)
abs CSnd(p) == p (λx. λy. y)

soft I, K, S, Bcomb, CFlip, W
soft CNat, C0, C1, C2, C3, CSucc, CPlus, CMult, CToInt
soft CBool, CTrue, CFalse, CIf, CAnd, COr, CNot
soft CPair, CFst, CSnd

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Combinator typing and conversion
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem i_ty :
  ∀A:U{i}. A → A
proof
  intro A
  intro x
  hyp
qed

theorem k_ty :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. A → B → A
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro x
  intro y
  hyp 3
qed

theorem s_ty :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}.
    (A → B → C) → (A → B) → A → C
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro f
  intro g
  intro x
  elim 5 with x THENL [
    hyp,
    elim 4 with x THENL [hyp, elim 8 with y THENL [hyp, hyp]]
  ]
qed

theorem b_ty :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}. (B → C) → (A → B) → A → C
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro f
  intro g
  intro x
  elim 5 with x THENL [hyp, elim 4 with y THENL [hyp, hyp]]
qed

theorem w_ty :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. (A → A → B) → A → B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro f
  intro x
  elim 3 with x THENL [
    hyp,
    elim 5 with x THENL [hyp, hyp]
  ]
qed

-- `S K K` converts with `I`.
theorem skk :
  ∀A:U{i}. S K K = I ∈ (A → A)
proof
  intro A
  eq THEN auto
qed

theorem ski_k :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀x:A. ∀y:B. K x y = x ∈ A
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro x
  intro y
  auto
qed

theorem b_red :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}. ∀f:(B → C). ∀g:(A → B). ∀x:A.
    Bcomb f g x = f (g x) ∈ C
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro f
  intro g
  intro x
  reduce
  auto
qed

theorem cflip_red :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}. ∀f:(A → B → C). ∀x:B. ∀y:A.
    CFlip f x y = f y x ∈ C
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro f
  intro x
  intro y
  reduce
  auto
qed

theorem w_red :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀f:(A → A → B). ∀x:A.
    W f x = f x x ∈ B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro f
  intro x
  reduce
  auto
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Church numerals
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem c0_ty :
  C0 ∈ CNat
proof
  auto
qed

theorem c1_ty :
  C1 ∈ CNat
proof
  auto
qed

theorem c2_ty :
  C2 ∈ CNat
proof
  auto
qed

theorem csucc_c1 :
  CSucc C1 ∈ CNat
proof
  auto
qed

theorem cplus_c1_c2 :
  CPlus C1 C2 ∈ CNat
proof
  auto
qed

-- Exemplary concrete evaluations
theorem csucc_2 :
  CToInt(CSucc C2) = 3 ∈ Int
proof
  eq
qed

theorem cplus_2_3 :
  CToInt(CPlus C2 C3) = 5 ∈ Int
proof
  eq
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Church booleans
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem ctrue_ty :
  CTrue ∈ CBool
proof
  auto
qed

theorem cfalse_ty :
  CFalse ∈ CBool
proof
  auto
qed

theorem cif_true_poly :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀x:A. ∀y:A.
    CIf(CTrue) x y = x ∈ A
proof
  intro A
  intro x
  intro y
  reduce
  auto
qed

theorem cif_false_poly :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀x:A. ∀y:A.
    CIf(CFalse) x y = y ∈ A
proof
  intro A
  intro x
  intro y
  reduce
  auto
qed

theorem cand_true_l :
  ∀b:CBool. CAnd(CTrue; b) = b ∈ CBool
proof
  intro b
  reduce
  auto
qed

theorem cnot_true :
  CNot(CTrue) = CFalse ∈ CBool
proof
  reduce
  auto
qed

-- Exemplary boolean test
theorem cif_example :
  CIf(CTrue) 7 9 = 7 ∈ Int
proof
  eq
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Church pairs
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem cpair_fst_poly :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀x:A. ∀y:B.
    CFst(CPair(x; y)) = x ∈ A
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro x
  intro y
  reduce
  auto
qed

theorem cpair_snd_poly :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀x:A. ∀y:B.
    CSnd(CPair(x; y)) = y ∈ B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro x
  intro y
  reduce
  auto
qed

-- Exemplary Church pair of numerals
theorem cpair_nats :
  CToInt(CFst(CPair(C2; C3))) = 2 ∈ Int
proof
  eq
qed
